Hero_Desc_Shasha: An unfortunate sprite who somehow ended up with a cursed tumbler and suffers because of it She became a unique firefighting sprite and is currently the first to rush to fire situations in the Sprite Kingdom after learning how to utilize the Tumbler. She is well-known for using her water cannon to put out fires and completely destroy the scene.
Album_Like_Shasha: The dry, comfortable center of the kingdom
Album_Hate_Shasha: Her room always being damp because of the magical tumbler
Album_Hobby_Shasha: Training the tumbler, using it to play with young Beastfolk
Album_Wish_Shasha: To gain perfect control over the tumbler
Album_Shasha1: While walking through the streets of the Sprite Kingdom, I accidentally bumped into Shasha. Just as I was about to apologize, a water cannon erupted from her tumbler and sent me flying about a meter. Apparently, Shasha's tumbler produces an endless supply of water.
Album_Shasha2: Shasha says she is always worried about her badly behaved tumbler firing water cannons everywhere. She complained that even if she throws it away, it ultimately returns to her.
Album_Shasha3: Shasha says she trains the tumbler firmly to keep it from inconveniencing others. While training it, she becomes exceptionally stern and frightening, quite unlike her usual self.
Album_Shasha4: Though generally troublesome, Shasha's tumbler is invaluable during fires because it loves extinguishing them. In the Sprite Kingdom, where another fire breaks out just when everyone has forgotten the last, it is tremendously useful.
Album_Shasha5: Perhaps because she is timid, Shasha seems unable to speak decisively in conversation. If only half the confidence she shows when scolding the tumbler appeared in her daily life.
Album_Shasha6: Shasha once used her tumbler to create a pool playground for the Sprites. Watching the Sprites play happily seemed to delight Shasha herself, and their joy made me proud as well.
Album_Shasha7: None other than Naia created Shasha's ill-tempered tumbler that loves tormenting others. She apparently made it with Gabia's help... I asked Naia how, but she said she had already forgotten. Shasha sometimes visits Naia to report that the tumbler remains healthy and well.
LoveHero_Shasha: Th-Thank you!! How could I ever repay this kindness...?!
LoveHeroCancel_Shasha: Did I perhaps do something terribly wrong...? Sob...
Food_ChefNote_Shasha_Hate1: Shasha said it falls out of her tumbler so often that she doesn't even want to see it as food anymore.
Food_ChefNote_Shasha_Hate2: After taking one bite, Shasha scrunched up her face at the distinctive cinnamon flavor. She quietly pushed the candy away, saying it wasn't to her liking.
Food_ChefNote_Shasha_Like1: She really liked the simple and modest taste. She said she'd want to eat it every morning.
Food_ChefNote_Shasha_Like10: She said the novel flavor restored her energy and would be perfect whenever firefighting work left her tired and exhausted.
Food_ChefNote_Shasha_Like2: She seems to prefer the strawberries on top rather than the cake itself, quietly muttering that she wants to eat more "cake strawberries."
Food_ChefNote_Shasha_Like3: It was nice watching her blow on her food and eat it with such care. She carefully picked off the rice cakes one by one to eat them.
Food_ChefNote_Shasha_Like4: Being a sprite, she seems to like cake just fine. She cleaned her plate with a happy expression.
Food_ChefNote_Shasha_Like5: She split it in half, dissolving one piece in water to drink and popping the other into her mouth. She seemed troubled, saying it was delicious no matter how she ate it.
Food_ChefNote_Shasha_Like6: She looked a bit troubled, saying it's so easy to keep eating due to its bite-size. She's worried she might end up becoming an especially chubby fairy at this rate.
Food_ChefNote_Shasha_Like7: She liked how the hidden bitter taste in between made the sweetness stand out even more.
Food_ChefNote_Shasha_Like8: She was completely captivated by the sweet taste that was both tangy and subtly present. She said with food like this, she could put out fires even more enthusiastically.
Food_ChefNote_Shasha_Like9: She worried that the candy was too pretty to eat. After much deliberation, she took a bite and shed tears, saying the taste was even better.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_Shasha: Why is the tumbler so well behaved today...?
Gacha_Result_Line1_Shasha: I may not know much else, but I am excellent at putting out fires!
Shasha_Spawn1: Special Fire Chief reporting for duty!
Shasha_Spawn2: Let us go, Tumbler! All I have to do is stay calm!
Shasha_Victory1: Fire suppression complete! The scene is safe now.
Shasha_Defeat1: Uuugh, Tumbler, you should have tried just a little harder.
Shasha_Defeat2: Ugh, I have to run away quickly.

Shasha_Affinity6: You are thirsty...? It would be best not to consider drinking water from this Tumbler...
Shasha_Affinity7: When Tumbler sulks, it refuses to spray water... It never sprays when I truly need it...
Shasha_Die1: I am making a tactical retreat! I am sorry!
Shasha_Die2: This is too much for me...
Shasha_Equipment: I will put it to good use!
Shasha_HeroUpgrade: I have become the mightiest Special Fire Chief!
Shasha_DeckSetting2: I will live up to your trust!
Shasha_Stage: This is the right way, is it not?

Shasha_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: Ouch! You are messing up my clothes! Please stop!

Shasha_Growth1_Skin2: The coral reef is beautiful, is it not?
Shasha_Growth2_Skin2: I will place the sea inside Tumbler for you.
Shasha_LevelUp_Skin2: I will become a stronger fairy.
Shasha_Equipment_Skin2: I will take even better care of the coral reef.
Shasha_HeroSkill_Skin2: The power of the sea has grown stronger.
Shasha_Touch1_1_Skin2: Please do not pull the coral.
Shasha_Touch1_2_Skin2: Are you trying to make me cry...?
Shasha_Touch2_1_Skin2: I think I might be a little sleepy... Hehe.
Shasha_Touch2_2_Skin2: You are saying I look pretty, right?
Shasha_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: Eek! What's suddenly gotten into you?!

Shasha_Growth2_Skin3: I wish I could carry the sky home inside Tumbler.
Shasha_LevelUp_Skin3: I will keep you safe all the way to your destination.

Shasha_Touch2_1_Skin3: Ehehe... As soft and fluffy as a cloud...

Aside_Get_Shasha1: Now I don't have to dry my clothes every time I use Tumbler!
Aside_Upgrade_Shasha1: Tumbler, now feel free to hose your water!
Shasha_AsideGet: Now I don't have to dry my clothes every time I use Tumbler!
Shasha_AsideUpgrade: Tumbler, you can spray all you want without worrying!
Shasha_Anger3: That is too much, is it not?
Shasha_Birthday: Happy birthday, Master. Tumbler says happy birthday too.
Shasha_Gacha2: I may not know much else, but I am excellent at putting out fires.
Shasha_Gacha3: Huh? Tumbler is unusually quiet today.
Shasha_Line1: When there is a fire, you must respond faster than anyone else.
Shasha_Line2: I am the Sprite Kingdom's one and only Special Fire Chief!
Shasha_Line3: Fire is truly dangerous. But this tumbler is dangerous too.
Shasha_Lobby: I feel a little uneasy in places that are too open.
LoveLetter_Shasha: Master! It feels like only yesterday that I found the tumbler. It is entirely thanks to you that I learned to handle it properly, and I am truly grateful. The tumbler helped me become a Special Firefighter Sprite and receive the gratitude of other Sprites, so every day is happy! I do not know how I could ever repay everything you have done for me...! Extinguishing fires is the only thing I can do, so I will repay you that way. If a fire ever breaks out at the Order, I solemnly promise to arrive first, put it out, and rescue you too! Please continue to take good care of me, Master!
LoveCall_Shasha:
Hello, Master~ I did not startle you by calling so suddenly, did I?
I should have called more often... Hehe. I am sorry, Master.
Since becoming an honorary firefighter, I have been so busy traveling from place to place that I have struggled to find the time.
I am truly relieved that you seem to be doing well...! The tumbler and I have been getting along nicely too.

Master...! I will continue working hard as a firefighter, and I promise not to fight with the tumbler... So may I visit you at the banquet hall a little more often from now on?
Eating delicious food and sharing quiet conversations with you there is such a precious and happy time for me...!
O-Of course, if that request is too unreasonable, you may refuse! The banquet hall is always crowded, and you are busy. I can understand...!

Hehe, I feel embarrassed now that I have said it aloud. Then, shall we meet again soon? Please always take care of yourself!

Affinity_Shasha_EP09_004: Did she ask whether you would become her apprentice?

Affinity_Shasha_EP10_006: It feels as though this place will soon become damp too...
Affinity_Shasha_EP10_007: Ah... I shall speak firmly to Tumbler so that does not happen! Please do not worry too much...!
